It often develops silently over many years and may only be discovered after a minor fall or injury causes a fracture. Early diagnosis and treatment are essential to maintain bone strength and prevent complications.
Common Signs & Risk Factors
Frequent back pain
Loss of height over time
Stooped posture
Fractures after minor falls
Age above 50 years
Post-menopausal women
Low calcium and vitamin D intake
Sedentary lifestyle
How Osteoporosis Is Diagnosed
Diagnosis usually involves a Bone Mineral Density (BMD) test, commonly known as a DEXA scan, which measures bone strength and fracture risk.
Treatment Options
At Dr Patil’s Orthopaedic Clinic, osteoporosis management focuses on strengthening bones and preventing fractures.
✔ Bone density screening
✔ Calcium and Vitamin D guidance
✔ Medications to improve bone strength
✔ Lifestyle and exercise recommendations

Prevention Tips
Maintain a calcium-rich diet
Ensure adequate vitamin D exposure
Engage in regular weight-bearing exercise

Schedule regular bone health check-ups

Sports Injury Treatment

Sports and physical activities are important for maintaining fitness, but injuries can occur due to sudden movements, overuse, or accidents. Sports injury treatment focuses on diagnosing and managing injuries affecting muscles, ligaments, tendons, and joints. Dr. Sachin Bhat, Orthopedic Surgeon in Goregaon and Vile Parle, provides specialized care for athletes and active individuals dealing with sports-related injuries.

Common sports injuries include ligament tears, meniscus injuries, tendon strains, muscle sprains, and joint dislocations. Early diagnosis helps determine the severity of the injury and allows doctors to recommend the most effective treatment plan.

Treatment may include medication, physiotherapy, rehabilitation exercises, minimally invasive procedures, or surgery depending on the condition. The goal of treatment is to relieve pain, restore mobility, and help patients safely return to their activities.

Rehabilitation programs also focus on strengthening muscles and improving joint stability to prevent future injuries. With proper medical care and guided recovery, many patients regain full function and continue their active lifestyle.

If you are experiencing joint pain, swelling, or limited movement after a sports injury, seeking orthopedic consultation is important for proper recovery.

Arthritis Treatment

Arthritis is a common condition that causes pain, swelling, stiffness, and reduced mobility in the joints. It can affect people of all ages and may worsen over time if not treated properly. Dr. Sachin Bhat, Orthopedic Surgeon serving Goregaon, Vile Parle, and Andheri, provides comprehensive arthritis management to help patients reduce pain and improve joint function.

Arthritis can occur due to aging, joint wear and tear, autoimmune conditions, or previous injuries. Early diagnosis is important to slow the progression of the disease and protect joint health.

Treatment options for arthritis may include medications to control inflammation, physiotherapy to strengthen muscles around the joints, lifestyle modifications, and advanced procedures if required. In severe cases where joint damage is extensive, joint replacement surgery may be recommended.

Effective arthritis treatment focuses on reducing pain, improving flexibility, and enhancing the patient’s ability to perform daily activities comfortably. With proper care and regular monitoring, many patients can successfully manage arthritis and maintain an active lifestyle.

If you are experiencing persistent joint pain, swelling, or stiffness, consulting an orthopedic specialist can help identify the cause and provide the right treatment plan.

Trauma Surgery

Orthopedic trauma refers to serious injuries affecting bones, joints, or soft tissues caused by accidents, falls, or high-impact injuries. Trauma surgery plays a critical role in treating complex fractures and restoring proper function to injured areas. Dr. Sachin Bhat, experienced Orthopedic Trauma Surgeon in Goregaon and Vile Parle, provides advanced treatment for traumatic bone and joint injuries.

Trauma injuries may involve fractures, dislocations, ligament damage, or multiple bone injuries that require immediate medical attention. Prompt surgical intervention helps stabilize the injured area, restore proper alignment of bones, and prevent long-term complications.

Trauma surgery often involves advanced orthopedic techniques such as internal fixation using plates, screws, or rods to support the healing process. Proper treatment ensures the injured bone heals correctly and helps restore normal movement and function.

Following trauma surgery, patients may require rehabilitation and physiotherapy to regain strength and mobility. Early treatment and expert care play a crucial role in improving recovery outcomes and preventing long-term disability.

If you have suffered a serious injury due to an accident or fall, timely consultation with an orthopedic specialist is essential.

Fracture Treatment

Bone fractures can occur due to accidents, falls, sports injuries, or sudden trauma. Prompt and proper fracture treatment is essential to ensure correct bone healing and prevent long-term complications. Dr. Sachin Bhat, Orthopedic Surgeon serving Goregaon, Vile Parle, and Andheri, provides expert diagnosis and treatment for a wide range of fractures and bone injuries.

Fractures can vary in severity, from small cracks in the bone to complete breaks that require specialized medical treatment. Accurate diagnosis using imaging tests helps determine the location and type of fracture so that the most appropriate treatment plan can be developed.

Treatment options may include immobilization using casts or braces, medications for pain management, or surgical procedures for complex fractures that require internal fixation. The goal of fracture treatment is to ensure proper alignment of the bone so it heals correctly.

Timely orthopedic care helps reduce the risk of complications such as improper healing, joint stiffness, or reduced mobility. Rehabilitation exercises may also be recommended to restore strength and flexibility once the bone heals.
